verdict.rationale: The Smithery CLI once documented `smithery tool find [query]` and `smithery tool call`, which resembled runtime tool search and invocation. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says the CLI, SDKs, Connect and Toolbox stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a non-proxied registry. With no surviving mechanism for an agent to search and load tools on demand, the current product does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
